model: LGB+XGB+CAT blend (calendar + cyclical + categorical features, log1p target)
notes: Time-based CV (TimeSeriesSplit on unique dates) chosen because test=2022 is strictly after train=2017-2021 with zero date overlap (see scripts/eda.py). Features: calendar (year/month/day/dow/doy/weekofyear/quarter), cyclical sin/cos for month/dow/doy, is_weekend/is_month_start/is_month_end/is_new_year flags, and label-encoded country/store/product used natively as categoricals in all three models. Target trained as log1p(num_sold), inverted with expm1 before SMAPE scoring. Final models retrained on 100% of training data before generating the submission.

model: DIAGNOSTIC: LGB+XGB+CAT blend, same 20 engineered features, plain shuffled 5-fold KFold
notes: Reflexion diagnostic, not used for submission. Purpose: isolate whether experiment #2's much worse SMAPE (10.17540 vs baseline 5.31891) comes from the CV *scheme* (time-based extrapolation is a harder, more honest test) or from the engineered feature set itself. Same 20 features and same 3 models as experiment #2, but validated with plain shuffled row-level 5-fold KFold (matching what the baseline experiment #1 almost certainly used, since its log has no time-awareness field). If this diagnostic scores close to or better than 5.31891, the feature engineering is sound and the CV-scheme choice (documented in scripts/eda.py) fully explains the gap.

model: LGB+CAT+RatioDecomp blend (XGB dropped: weight-searched to 0 in exp #2/#3)
notes: Phase B round 1: added ratio-decomposition model (RD) as a new ensemble member. RD = harmonic linear regression (not GBDT) for the daily grand-total trend/seasonality x per-country linear-trend-extrapolated share (renormalized to sum 1 per year) x pooled store/product share within country (near-constant per EDA). Pre-check: additive OLS of log1p(num_sold) on country+store+product alone (no date) explains R^2=0.974 of target variance, motivating this decomposition. Same TimeSeriesSplit 5-fold CV as exp #2 for direct comparability. XGB dropped per instruction (weight-searched to 0 twice already).

model: LGB(seed42)+LGB(seed2024)+CAT seed-bagged blend (RD rejected in exp #4; XGB dropped)
notes: Phase B round 2: after ratio-decomposition (exp #4) was rejected (RD weight-searched to 0, solo OOF 14.75 vs LGB 10.18 -- the structural signal does NOT beat GBDT here, unlike s3e20; oracle diagnostics showed the bottleneck is grand-total trend forecasting under a volatile 5-year/COVID-affected series, not the store/product/country share decomposition itself, which roughly matches GBDT when given the true total), pivoted to a cheap validated pattern from experience.md: seed bagging the dominant LGB member. Added LGB(seed=2024) alongside the original LGB(seed=42) and CAT(seed=42); XGB stays dropped (weight-searched to 0 in exp #2/#3).

model: LGB(3 seeds)+CAT(2 seeds) seed-bagged blend (RD rejected in exp #4; XGB dropped)
notes: Phase B round 3: extended round 2's seed bagging (exp #5, 10.17489 -> 10.16605 with LGB seed42+seed2024+CAT seed42) by adding a third LGB seed (7) and a second CAT seed (2024), 5-way weight search (grid_step 0.1, all 5 members present so search space is large -- coarser step than exp #5 to keep runtime bounded). Tests whether seed-bagging gains continue with diminishing returns (per experience.md pattern across s3e9/s3e14) or have plateaued after round 2.

notes: Tree-search result (Phase D-5, harness v2, 2026-07-04) — NOT a linear-iteration round; trains on the same 20-feature set as experiment_id=7. Source: experiments_tree.json, node #17 (22 evaluated nodes total: 13 solo/9 blend, 0 failed, wall 321.0s total; this node found at evaluation #18 of 22, node wall_s=21.8s, as a 10-way blend with an auto_scale global multiplier applied INSIDE metric_fn). Weight search: dirichlet, scale_used=1.02. Beats linear-iteration best (experiment_id=7, 10.019463) by -0.262393 (~-2.62% relative) — the largest relative sweep margin of any comp tested with harness v2. The two decisive levers: (1) seed-bagging the Optuna-tuned LGB itself (node #6, SEEDBAG_TUNED_S2024, solo 9.974778) — an idea STATUS.md explicitly flagged as untried and cautioned might be neutral (per s3e5's counter-example for directly-tuned configs), but here it single-handedly beat the entire linear 6-way blend as a solo, because the tuned config was fitted on a fold-5 PROXY (not the full-OOF metric), leaving real seed variance for bagging to reduce; (2) a global x1.02 OOF-fitted multiplier (auto_scale) correcting a systematic ~2% low bias in TimeSeriesSplit OOF predictions (every validation block is later in time than its training window, and the series grows into 2021) — the single largest gain of the run (-0.168 at the 8-way layer, node #15). IMPORTANT CAVEAT (verbatim from STATUS.md Appendix 'Phase D-5 tree-search v2 sweep — the TIME-SERIES case'): 'like the linear 10.01946, the 9.75707 carries fold-5 double-dip optimism, PLUS the scale parameter and the seed selection are OOF-fitted. All are 1-to-few-parameter fits on 114k rows (low overfit risk individually), but the true expected 2022 SMAPE is best read as "meaningfully below 10.02", not literally 9.76.'
